name: com.usenym/scout-order
title: Order The Scout (Nym)
description: Pre-order The Scout ($25 no-subscription Wi-Fi camera): check specs, quote US shipping/tax, and pay.

tools.name: scout_details
tools.description: Everything to help someone choose: what The Scout is, today's price and sale, what an order of ten comes with, where Scouts go and which color suits each spot, pictures and a film to show, the Nym plans, and how it ships. Call this before ordering.

tools.name: scout_order
tools.description: Price an order of Scouts in full for the address it ships to: the Scouts, any sale, shipping and sales tax. Returns the total and the ways to pay it. Nothing is charged by this call.

email.description: The buyer's email address, for the order confirmation.

ship_to.description: Where the order ships, in the US.

tools.name: scout_pay
tools.description: Pay a priced order from the buyer's wallet over the Machine Payments Protocol. Called without a payment it answers with the payment required; a payment-aware client pays and calls again. `order` is `pay.from_link_wallet.order` from scout_order.
